source_publication_scope: Exact content-frozen source executed before cohesive publication; prior dirty-tree Git HEAD is not claimed as the tested source. Publication must verify these file hashes.
account_identity: Eight fresh independent corrected-source qualification/counterfactual accounts. Original f1074b1 primary and its six controls are preserved separately; no account reset, migration, replacement or pooled profit.

qualification.scope: Native semantics, complete declared costs, source/provenance checks, interrupted authority recovery, portable audit versus live resume distinction, and all-eight post-crash live reconciliations. Not whole-repository or production-release qualification.

execution_order.deviation: The core runner was already queued after the 20-test command and started before the later crash-wait instruction took effect. These executions are engineering replays, not prequalified executions. All eight completed accounts were independently audited and authoritatively reopened after the crash tests passed, with unchanged financial histories and authority. No replacement accounts were created to hide the deviation.

period: [0,365) simulated days, not calendar demand or annualization of a shorter run
economics_scope: All stated collections, costs, tax and profit are simulated under declared authored envelopes. Demand and actual lifecycle prices remain unmeasured. Independent accounts are never pooled.

adaptive_decision_result.nonentry: A separate high-cost regression proves no private observation, quote, wallet or order on NONENTRY, with sunk setup/discovery/maintenance retained.

successor_scope: Positive arms each spend an unchanged $5 authored R&D envelope from native unrestricted earnings on verified fresh cart construction and source-grounded productive successor outputs. Equal-content reuse and conventional output tie; opening capital permits alternative construction, so earnings are not shown causally necessary. Proposed cooperative contributions are not native received money.

native_summary.fundingScope: Bounded principal-plus-fee exposure; arbitrary additional debits are not guaranteed
native_summary.assuranceScope: Local provider assumption only; full late-debit reserve retained for conservative investment

policy.objective: Largest verified expected seller contribution in the declared public market; fixed lifecycle costs excluded.
policy.nonentry: Do not quote or observe a private buyer when no candidate has positive expected contribution.
policy.positive_ties: Remove only Pareto-dominated same-constructor construction rows and deviation checks; retain all remaining ties.
policy.last_tie_break: Lexical arm name, an explicit reproducibility convention with no economic superiority claim.
policy.cost_boundary: Work counts are comparable within this cart constructor only; all campaign work is already incurred and remains charged. Unknown dollar costs are not zero.

sunk_study_work.basis: All study arms and failed attempts remain incurred; selected-program work is not the cost of the complete study.

decision.scope: Decision gate over available verified programs using declared public expectations. No new invention advantage, observed demand, strategic response cycle or complete-cost optimality claim.
